reason: A desktop companion plugin that renders configurable animated pet overlays reflecting DeepSeek Harness activity and supports importing compatible pet assets.

summaries.zh: 在桌面上显示可配置的宠物叠加窗口，并根据 DeepSeek Harness 的活动状态切换动画与提示。
summaries.en: Displays configurable animated desktop pet overlays that reflect DeepSeek Harness activity and support compatible pet asset imports.

capabilities: Displays native desktop pet overlay windows
Observes DeepSeek Harness lifecycle and agent-status events
Provides a settings UI for pet selection, visibility, size, position, and animation
Imports pet packages from uploaded ZIP files or Petdex slugs
Downloads and persists imported pet assets locally
Stores plugin configuration and per-pet state on the local filesystem
